params.title: Fake seller, many small victims
params.source: Prepayment fraud typology; share of online fraud - research/01

hints: Drop cards are older than 14 days (around 30), so the "young account" rule stays silent. Bought "warmed-up" cards get around it.
1 card on one phone, the rule threshold is 3. The link is visible only in the graph.
Money moves on after ~17 min, while the victim notices the loss after 12 h on average.
The rules spot every chain, but too late: the account is frozen 30 min after the alert, and the money is already out by then. Real-time reaction is needed.
